data.title: Turning real life into cinema

data.title: Test bureau boss faces 7 criminal charges
data.description: The director of Srinakharinwirot University's Educational and Psychological Test Bureau has acknowledged seven criminal charges in an alleged fraud involving recruitment examinations for local government positions.

data.title: Govt eyes boost to investment
data.description: Thailand aims to raise total investment to 30% of GDP to escape the middle-income trap and achieve high-income status within the next 12 years, Finance Minister Ekniti Nitithanprapas said.

data.title: War Elephants face acid test
data.description: Seven-times champions Thailand will take on arch-rivals Malaysia in an Asean Hyundai Cup Group B fixture at Bangkok's Rajamangala Stadium on Saturday night, in what promises to be one of the standout ties of the group phase.

data.title: 210,000 appeal welfare card rules
data.description: More than 210,000 people have appealed for an eligibility review under the state welfare card programme following a revision to the vehicle ownership criteria, according to the government.

data.title: Hamas agrees to disarm under Trump plan
data.description: GAZA CITY (PALESTINIAN TERRITORIES) - Hamas said Friday it had agreed to a deal that includes handing over its weapons to a Palestinian governing committee and the gradual withdrawal of Israeli forces from the Gaza Strip.

data.title: 20,000 Cambodians ‘still displaced’ along Thai border
data.description: PHNOM PENH - ⁠More ⁠than 20,000 Cambodian civilians remain ​displaced along the country’s border with Thailand following two rounds of ​fighting between the Southeast Asian neighbours ‌last year, a UN expert said on Friday, following a visit to the disputed frontier.

data.title: Minors’ digital money transfers capped to fight fraud
data.description: The Bank of Thailand is introducing daily limits on digital money transfers by young account holders after finding a sharp rise in the use of minors’ bank and e-money accounts as “mule accounts” by fraudsters.

data.title: A rumour, a rush, and chaos next door to Ceuta
data.description: FNIDEQ, Morocco - When Fatima Zahra heard the rumour of a rare border opening between Morocco and Spain, she joined thousands in rushing to attempt a perilous journey into the Ceuta enclave by land or sea.

data.title: Indonesia arrests Malaysian pilot with 26kg of MDMA
data.description: JAKARTA - Indonesia arrested a Malaysian pilot who allegedly smuggled ​26 kilogrammes of the ‌mind-altering drug MDMA into the capital Jakarta while on the job and under the influence of drugs, the customs office said on Friday.

data.title: Insurer to cover cost of bringing Hlun Solo's body home
data.description: Sompo Insurance (Thailand) has pledged to cover, in full, the cost of repatriating the body of travel YouTuber Bowornthat Pengsuk, known as Hlun Solo, who has died in Georgia at the age of 27.

data.title: Russian siblings dead, suspects confess
data.description: SA KAEO - Two men wanted in connection with the disappearance of two Russian siblings in Chon Buri have been arrested and reportedly confessed that the pair were killed and buried in a remote area, police said on Friday.

data.title: Thousands more cross into Spain’s north African enclave
data.description: CEUTA, Spain - Thousands of migrants crossed overnight from Morocco into the Spanish enclave of Ceuta in north Africa, a police source said on Friday, as Prime Minister Pedro Sanchez was set to arrive to manage the latest migrant crisis on the border.

data.title: New fronts open in Europe’s wildfire battle
data.description: Greek firefighters faced another day of battling flames in high-risk conditions for new ignitions on Friday as France and Spain hoped for reprieve from massive infernos that blackened swathes of terrain.

data.description: The BOJ voted 8–1 to keep its policy rate unchanged at 1%, while reiterating that borrowing costs could rise further if inflation risks intensify

data.title: Samut Sakhon and Thainakarin Hospitals Strengthen Kidney Transplant Network Via Seminar
data.description: SAMUT SAKHON, Thailand – July 20, 2026 – Samut Sakhon Hospital, in collaboration with Thainakarin Hospital, hosted the Kidney Transplant Program Preparation Seminar at the Sawat Raiwa Conference Room, 7th Floor, Emergency Building, Samut Sakhon Hospital. The event brought together more than 60 physicians, nurses and multidisciplinary healthcare professionals to advance the development of kidney transplantation services and strengthen regional healthcare capacity.

data.title: DITP and RX BITEC Present TILOG – LOGISTIX 2026 Empowering Thailand's Supply Chains for Global Trade
data.description: The Department of International Trade Promotion (DITP), Ministry of Commerce, in collaboration with RX BITEC and logistics industry partners, is set to host TILOG – LOGISTIX 2026, ASEAN’s most comprehensive exhibition on technologies and services for warehouse management, loading, packing, material handling, and transportation from 19–21 August 2026, 10am–6pm, at Hall 98, BITEC Bangkok.

data.title: Fragrance becomes flavour in Bangkok afternoon tea experience
data.description: At Mandarin Oriental, Bangkok fragrance and flavour meet in a limited-edition afternoon tea inspired by Parfums Dusita’s Light of Bangkok, at Authors’ Lounge, August 1–31, 2026.
